senses.gloss:
आढ्य आढ्य, अस्, आ, अम् (etym. doubtful,
perhaps for आर्ध्य fr. ऋध्), opulent, wealthy, rich;
(with an inst. or as last member of a comp.) rich in,
abounding in, productive; possessing abundantly; mixed
with, watered with; abundant, existing in abundance.
—आढ्यकुलीन, अस्, आ, अम्, descended from a rich
family.
—आढ्यङ्-करण, अस्, ई, अम्, enriching;
(अम्), n. the means of enriching, wealth, prosperity.
—आढ्य-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, once opulent (?).
—आढ्य-
ता, f. opulence, wealth.
—आढ्यम्-भविष्णु, उस्,
उस्, उ, or आढ्यम्-भावुक, अस्, ई, अम्, becoming
rich or eminent.
—आढ्य-वात, अस्, m. (abundant
wind), a convulsive or rheumatic palsy of the loins.
—आढ्याडु (˚ढ्य-आडु), उस्, उस्, उ, striving to get
wealth.
आढ्यक, अम्, n. wealth, opulence, abundance.
